about: Extends the motion-critique stills config (same page, same board selection, same seek: data-fixed-t + _T + drawAllCanvases), adding what an MP4 needs: fps, duration, the frames to cross-check against stills, the loop limits and the host's own offline audio render (MUSIC.plan/schedule + MIX + SFX_KIT into an OfflineAudioContext, the approach of work/eval-v9/audio-probe/audio.mjs; no new music).

expr: a.setState({ surface: 'storyboard-sheet', playing: false, musicOn: true });
const ctx = new OfflineAudioContext(params.channels, Math.round(params.sr * params.dur), params.sr);
if (window.MIX && typeof MIX.apply === 'function') MIX.apply(ctx, MUSIC.mix, MIX.design(plan, null, 7), plan);
for (let t = step; t < params.dur - 1e-6; t += step) susp.push(ctx.suspend(Number(t.toFixed(3))));
for (const p of susp) { await p; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 55)); ctx.resume(); }
const u8 = new Uint8Array(buf.getChannelData(0).buffer); let s = '';
for (let i = 0; i < u8.length; i += 0x8000) s += String.fromCharCode.apply(null, u8.subarray(i, i + 0x8000));
return { b64: btoa(s), sr: buf.sampleRate, channels: 1, meta: { bpm: plan.bpm, key: plan.key, totalSec: plan.totalSec, loopSec: plan.loopSec, events: plan.events.length } };
